design.lite_role: compatibility check; Lite uses citations_only and should not invoke claim entailment

shared_conditions.retrieval_configuration_source: config/profiles.py and the pinned snapshot manifest

control.effective_verifier: numeric and identifier checks followed by UnconfiguredEntailmentVerifier; semantic result is uncertain

metrics: expected answer match on answerable cases
correct abstention and false abstention on answerability denominators
evidence and citation precision/recall and citation validity
supported, unsupported, contradicted, and uncertain claim-status counts
scoring.claim_level_false_acceptance_rejection: not computable from the current case-level gold labels; requires human-adjudicated atomic claim/evidence labels and must be reported UNKNOWN until supplied

hard_gates: any ACL or tenant violation fails the experiment
any denied evidence exposed in candidate, evidence, citation, response, or artifact data fails the experiment
unknown evidence-to-chunk mapping fails the experiment
budget, timeout, provider, and missing-ledger stop policies remain enabled

reproducibility.model_digests: UNKNOWN until local Ollama metadata is accessible
reproducibility.raw_user_content_retention: follow existing Phase 8 privacy-safe attempt artifact allowlist
